patch_description: This replaces bottleneck-focused local search with a population-based recombination strategy. It maintains a diverse archive of LP-scored networks, combines edges from different elites and repaired QAOA candidates, then uses the free repair operation to turn those mixtures into valid offspring. Occasional degree-preserving mutations help preserve exploration. The approach aims to cross between promising network structures that single-network swaps may not reach, while allocating LP calls to varied offspring rather than repeatedly probing one parent’s neighborhood.
